string-array.name: daily_theme_strong
string-array.item: The Moon is in your own sign. You feel clear and like yourself. Start the thing you have been putting off.
A good day to talk about money or plans with family. Kind words open doors today.
Courage comes easily. Make the call, send the message or take the short trip.
Home feels warm today. Spend time with family or tidy one corner you love.
Ideas flow. Learn something new, play, or help a child with their homework.
You can beat a stubborn problem today. Tackle the hardest task first.
Partners and friends are on your side. Plan something together.
A quiet strength is with you. Look into something you have been curious about.
Luck and good advice find you. Ask a teacher or elder for their view.
Work goes well. Show your effort; people notice today.
Wishes move closer. Reach out to a friend; a small gain is likely.
Rest restores you. Give time or help to someone, and sleep early.

string-array.name: daily_theme_steady
string-array.item: Steady and centred. Keep to your routine and look after your health.
Spend thoughtfully and speak gently at home. Small savings add up.
Good for small steps of courage. Finish one task you started.
Comfort matters today. Keep plans simple and stay close to home if you can.
Let your creative side play, but check details before you decide.
Keep up your daily habits. Steady effort clears today\'s obstacles.
Listen well in your relationships. A small kindness goes far.
Changes may come up. Stay flexible and keep important papers in order.
Read, reflect or pray. Wisdom comes quietly today.
Work moves at a steady pace. Plan tomorrow before you finish today.
Keep in touch with friends. Steady progress on a wish you hold.
Slow down when you can. Let go of one thing that no longer helps you.

string-array.name: daily_theme_gentle
string-array.item: Go easy on yourself. Eat well, rest, and keep the day light.
Think before you speak or spend. Today is for finishing, not starting.
Save your energy for what matters. Short, simple tasks are best.
Look after your peace at home. A calm evening will help.
Keep plans flexible. Enjoy simple pleasures and avoid big bets.
Pace yourself at work and in exercise. Rest is part of the plan.
Be patient with others. Leave big talks for another day.
A day to go slow and be careful. Finish old work and keep things simple.
Keep faith, even if things move slowly. Small prayers or reflection help.
Do your work quietly and well. Hold off on big career moves today.
Enjoy what you have. Wishes can wait a day.
Rest and recharge. Watch your spending and sleep early.

string-array.name: daily_tara
string-array.item: Your birth star returns today. A good day to check in with yourself.
A star of plenty. Good for money matters and practical plans.
A star that asks for care. Double-check before you commit.
A star of wellbeing. Look after your health and comfort.
A star of small hurdles. Patience gets you through.
A star of achievement. Effort today brings results.
A star that asks you to rest. Avoid big new starts today.
A friendly star. People are kind and helpful today.
Your best friend among the stars. A lovely day to begin something.

string-array.name: daily_vara
string-array.item: Sunday belongs to Surya. Step forward with confidence.
Monday belongs to Chandra. Look after your mind and your mood.
Tuesday belongs to Mangal. Put your energy into action.
Wednesday belongs to Budha. Good for learning, writing and trade.
Thursday belongs to Guru. Seek wisdom and share it.
Friday belongs to Shukra. Enjoy beauty, art and good company.
Saturday belongs to Shani. Steady, patient work pays off.

string-array.name: daily_rahu_tip
string-array.item: Keep new starts outside Rahu kaal. Use it to plan the rest of your good day.
Use Rahu kaal for routine work, and start new things before or after it.
Rest or finish small tasks during Rahu kaal. Leave anything new for later.
